notes:
- Customer voice: 'We need suggestions that don't slow agents down; sub-150ms feel is ideal.'
- Primary flows: live suggestion card (streaming tokens), automated post-call summary (one-paragraph), tool-calls to CRM, tokenized audit trail for compliance.
- Latency SLOs: p50 <60ms, p95 <120-150ms in normal load; scale to 2000 concurrent agents during campaign spikes.
- Quality guardrails: strict classification step before any tool-call; allow only whitelisted intents + step-down to read-only suggestions for high risk dialogs.
- Safety ask: mutable hallucination threshold metric + runbook for rapid rollback; want model fallback to smaller verified base-model, not simple api timeouts.
- Integration notes: Genesys Cloud + custom agent desktop (React); need streaming SSE/WS support and function-calling hooks (CRM:updateTicket).
- Security: requires SSO (SAML), KMS-managed keys, audit logging to SIEM; data residency in us-east region.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market deal, wants clear per-agent token economics and Optimize recommendations before commit.
- POC acceptance criteria: stable p95 latency under synthetic spike, <3% hallucination rate on eval set, successful tool-call roundtrip with no PII leakage.
- Docs/refs: security FAQ link in Drive; Fireflies transcript ff-3b7c9a for demo notes.
procurement_notes: Frame POC pricing as monthly reserved capacity + overage; procurement prefers 3-month pilot agreement. Legal asks for standard DPA + export control clauses.
technical_requirements: Streaming SSE or WebSocket API; function calling with async confirmation; prefix caching for common intents; KV cache for agent session; quantization acceptable if no regression on hallucination metrics.
sales_play: Position Dedicated + Optimize: guaranteed latency SLO + automated batching/caching recommendations; offer a 2-week bench test with Redwood to demonstrate p95 targets and cost model. Emphasize rollback/fallback routing to hosted models during spikes.
